label: Bible Study
prompt: He that is _____ to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verse: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
note: Self-control beats conquest — ruling your own spirit outranks taking a city.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The _____ of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verse: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
note: The very last verse of the whole Bible is a blessing of grace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a _____.
verse: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
note: David's victory song: by God's help he could run through a troop and leap over a wall.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of _____.
verse: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
note: After listing mercy, kindness and meekness to 'put on,' Paul names love as the bond that ties the outfit together.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I therefore so run, not as _____; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
verse: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
note: Paul the athlete doesn't run 'uncertainly' or shadowbox — 'not as one that beateth the air.'
